immutable_controller.scope_note: The pin files are outside the four declared task artifacts. They are required because test_dev_environment_lease_deploy_contract asserts the working CLI hash equals the pinned controller hash (a controller-only fix must reach the immutable workflow entry point); without them CI fails and the fix never runs. Change is a mechanical pin substitution only.
immutable_controller.integration_constraint: Merge with MERGE (not squash) so commit a4b0cdca2 stays reachable; workflows fetch this exact commit and verify both checksums.

AC1.behavior: LeaseManager._matching_remote raises InitialLeaseMissingPending (subclass of InitialLeaseVisibilityPending) on 404 only when verify() runs with initial_visibility_wait_seconds > 0; verify polls it with the same poll interval and the same visibility deadline as the stale-predecessor case. On timeout: LeaseLost('initial lease visibility remained missing (404) until the bounded timeout'). Heartbeat and verify without the window keep raising LeaseLost('remote dev environment lease is missing') at once. After a 404, the content must still match every acquisition immutable field (owner, leaseId, mode, acquiredAt, ...) or LeaseLost is raised.

AC2.unchanged: existing stale-predecessor tests (test_initial_verify_retries_only_the_exact_expired_predecessor, ..._times_out_if_exact_predecessor_remains_visible, ..._fails_immediately_for_wrong_predecessor_sha, ..._without_valid_predecessor_sha, ..._does_not_retry_predecessor_without_opt_in, ..._fails_immediately_for_foreign_active_replacement) are byte-identical and pass
